headline: Brazil Stocks Drop 13.9% Following Election Outcome Ahead of Central Bank Decisions
summary: Brazil's Ibovespa index dropped 13.9% as financial markets digested the presidential election outcome. Investors face a crucial week with interest rate decisions scheduled by global central banks.
why: The Ibovespa is Brazil's benchmark stock index, representing major companies listed on the B3 exchange in São Paulo.

impacts.name: Ibovespa
impacts.why: Post-election investor uncertainty triggered a sharp sell-off in Brazilian equities.

why_moved: Uncertainty following the presidential election outcome sparked a sharp sell-off in Brazilian equities ahead of upcoming central bank rate decisions.
